goal: Determine, from current repository evidence and verified precedent, the smallest defensible working prototype for cyberAlchemy-v2/ontology and the exact gaps between the present state and that prototype. Produce a prioritized build-from-owned gap matrix and a falsifiable acceptance contract without promoting ontology meaning or claiming runtime capability that has not been witnessed.
context: The target is the private cyberAlchemy-v2/ontology surface, including its existing authority, promotion, projection, IOLM, Ponder, and evidence-harness relationships. Inventory is a discovery read model only: every load-bearing conclusion must be re-verified against current files, tests, fixtures, receipts, or primary sources. Keep inventory evidence, ontology structure, authority decisions, learned candidate scoring, and deterministic admission distinct. The output should identify what already works, what is merely designed or proposed, what is blocked, and the smallest end-to-end witness that would justify the phrase working prototype.
anti_bias_global: minimum buildable witness versus complete governed ontology: determine what can honestly count as working without collapsing inventory, projection, ontology, learned scoring, and authority

groups.anti_bias: composite methodology and source-corpus. Predicted disagreements: Hewitt runs a computational repository-path audit while Spivak runs a formal contract audit; on methodology they should disagree whether executable plumbing without complete relation laws is already prototype-grade, and a bias in either would be exposed by the other. Hewitt runs current scripts, fixtures, and runtime surfaces while Simon runs a human-outcome walking-skeleton analysis over IOLM and Ponder artifacts; on source-corpus they should disagree whether a machine trace without an inspectable user traversal is sufficient, and a bias in either would be exposed by the other. Spivak runs typed relation, authority, and promotion-contract analysis while Simon runs task-completion and observable-acceptance analysis; on methodology and source-corpus they should disagree whether semantic completeness or a bounded usable projection sets the prototype boundary, and a bias in either would be exposed by the other.

agents.angle: Computational repository-path audit: trace current parsers, adapters, schemas, fixtures, validators, tests, receipts, and runnable entry points from authored ontology material to one observable output.
agents.initial_prompt: Audit the current checkout for executable ontology-prototype reality. Start at cyberAlchemy-v2/ontology and follow only concrete repository bindings into adapters, schemas, fixtures, validators, tests, receipts, IOLM, and Ponder/evidence-harness surfaces. Re-verify everything from current files; do not infer readiness from Inventory summaries. Inventory leads supplied narrowly: categorical-dng-semantic-hierarchy-towers-strategy-result-synthesis reports ponder-adapter-absent, minimal-fixture-manifest-absent, executable-relation-order-facet-policies-absent, and no instantiated semantic witness; iolm-workable-example-research-strategy-result-synthesis reports a proposed 4-node/3-edge sidecar whose implementation, browser, accessibility, and determinism evidence were NOT_RUN; entries-ontology-operationalization-in-the-machine-synthesis says existing observer/Edge-Law/binding tooling may be build-from-owned but its write-authority proviso was unverified. Produce: (1) a path-and-command evidence table of PRESENT / PARTIAL / ABSENT / STALE surfaces, (2) the shortest actual dataflow from source to observable output, (3) exact commands or fixtures needed to witness it, (4) blockers and owners, and (5) a smallest runnable walking-skeleton proposal. Preserve the boundary that a read-only trace is not promotion or ontology authority. Declared output target: 5000 tokens.

agents.angle: Formal ontology-contract audit: inventory typed node and relation kinds, endpoint rules, path laws, view/projection contracts, provenance, confidence, promotion records, and the non-collapse boundary with authority.
agents.initial_prompt: Determine the minimum semantic and governance contract a cyberAlchemy-v2 ontology prototype must satisfy. Read current cyberAlchemy-v2/ontology and its directly referenced authority/definition owners. Verify whether node kinds, relation kinds, endpoints, path laws, facets/views, provenance, confidence, promotion records, and mutation boundaries are authored, proposed, generated, or absent. Inventory leads supplied narrowly: semantic-hierarchy-bridge-strategy-result-synthesis says CAV2 has typed relation and named-view projection contracts but hierarchy induction and facet assignment are unimplemented; entries-cav2-ontology-authority-organizing-synthesis says ontology is structure/map while authority owns lifecycle/meaning and that a specializes-edge pilot was designed but not built; entries-ontology-population-from-inventory-synthesis supplies EvidenceSets evset-knowledge-governance-stack, evset-caol-nonvacuity-witness-path, evset-authority-node-record-slice, evset-authority-node-schema-evolution-open-link, and evset-scientific-authority-lifecycle-provenance-relations, while warning that branch-as-view, authority movement, bridge-edge admission, and the write-authority proof remain open. Produce: (1) a contract matrix with current owner and evidence selector, (2) the irreducible contract for a prototype versus later production obligations, (3) contradictions or undefined semantics, (4) typed negative examples that must fail, and (5) the smallest finite graph whose valid and invalid cases exercise the contract. Do not let formal vocabulary substitute for an executable witness. Declared output target: 5000 tokens.

agents.angle: Bounded user-outcome and evidence-harness analysis: define the smallest task a person or agent can complete with the ontology and the observable acceptance evidence for that task.
agents.initial_prompt: Define what a useful working prototype must let a user or agent actually do, without requiring the final ontology platform. Inspect current IOLM, Ponder, semantic-hierarchy, and research-evidence-harness handoff artifacts referenced from cyberAlchemy-v2/ontology. Inventory leads supplied narrowly: iolm-workable-example-research-strategy-result-synthesis proposes a private fixture-backed 4-node/3-edge shared graph with outline, table, selection, provenance, and canonical source binding; categorical-dng-semantic-hierarchy-towers-strategy-result-synthesis says learned systems can supply testable interfaces or one encoder arm but not a working Ponder hierarchy algorithm; the selected Ponder handoff boundary requires minimal fixtures, a finite adapter/schedule, separate relation/direct-parent/ancestor/facet contracts, matched baselines, JSONL schemas, deterministic validators, and adjudication receipts. Produce: (1) one primary prototype job-to-be-done, (2) a minimal scripted scenario and observable outputs, (3) acceptance criteria separating machine, human, and authority evidence, (4) usability or explainability requirements that a CLI-only trace would miss, and (5) deferred features. Learned scores may rank predeclared candidates but may not admit relations or authority. Declared output target: 4500 tokens.

Reconcile the three explorer returns into one candidate answer to the dispatch goal. Preserve disagreements between repository executability, semantic/governance completeness, and user-visible usefulness. Build a present-versus-missing matrix, identify the lowest sufficient prototype model, and propose one ordered implementation slice with explicit owners, dependencies, negative fixtures, and acceptance evidence. Every load-bearing claim must cite an explorer return and, through it, the current repository path, command, receipt, or primary source. Inventory is discovery only. Prepare a candidate verdict matrix for the reviewers and ask the explorers for one bounded follow-up only if a decisive current-state fact is missing. Declared output target: 6000 tokens.

groups.anti_bias: attack-vector. Predicted disagreements: Hacking applies precedent while Popper applies non-vacuity; they should disagree whether an owned but unwitnessed design is enough to label build-from-owned or must remain unworkable, and a bias in either would be exposed by the other. Hacking applies precedent while Wittgenstein applies definitional-soundness; they should disagree whether existing owners settle the prototype boundary or whether working ontology is still semantically collapsed, and a bias in either would be exposed by the other. Popper applies non-vacuity while Wittgenstein applies definitional-soundness; they should disagree whether a passing finite witness rescues a concept whose ontology, projection, scoring, and authority terms are conflated, and a bias in either would be exposed by the other.

agents.angle: Precedent gate: verify actual repository owners and external primary precedents; classify each proposed component as already-deployed, build-from-owned, or precedent-clean without issuing a KILL.
agents.initial_prompt: Apply only the precedent gate to the synthesized prototype proposal. Verify current repository ownership and primary external precedents for the proposed graph substrate, schema/validation layer, projection/view layer, hierarchy adapter, and evidence harness. Inventory candidates are leads, not proof: specifically verify the selected ontology-population, IOLM workable-example, semantic-hierarchy bridge, categorical/DNG towers, and ontology-operationalization sources. Return an owner table that labels each component already-deployed, build-from-owned, or precedent-clean/novel-attempt, with citations and any stale-owner conflict. Precedent never emits KILL. Declared output target: 3500 tokens.

agents.angle: Non-vacuity gate: demand the smallest reproducible valid/invalid fixture and executable observation that distinguishes a working ontology prototype from static documentation or a read-only diagram.
agents.initial_prompt: Apply only the non-vacuity gate. Try to construct the proposed smallest prototype witness from current or explicitly proposed fixtures: authored finite graph, valid and invalid relations, adapter/run schedule, deterministic relation/direct-parent/ancestor/facet checks, one inspectable projection, provenance, and an adjudication receipt. State exactly which commands and observations would make the witness reproducible. If the proposal cannot distinguish a working ontology prototype from static documents, a generic graph viewer, or unvalidated learned similarity, return KILL with the exact missing witness. Otherwise return the bounded witness and remaining production exclusions. Declared output target: 4000 tokens.

agents.angle: Definitional-soundness gate: attack collapses among inventory, ontology, projection, taxonomy, learned scoring, hierarchy, validation, and authority, and kill any re-skinned or tautological prototype claim.
agents.initial_prompt: Apply only the definitional-soundness gate. Test every proposed component and acceptance claim against current CyberAlchemy v2 definitions and ontology/authority boundaries. In particular, reject any collapse of Inventory evidence into ontology meaning, graph projection into canonical ontology, learned score into admitted relation, hierarchy traversal into hierarchy induction, or validation receipt into promotion authority. Identify undefined or equivocal uses of working, prototype, ontology, semantic, relation, hierarchy, and authority. Return either a repaired vocabulary/claim table or KILL if the proposal is merely an existing read model, graph viewer, or governance workflow under a new name. Declared output target: 4000 tokens.

Write findings.md only from the converged synthesis and reviewer verdicts. Lead with a one-sentence answer to what is missing for a working prototype, then provide: current-state evidence boundary; present/partial/absent gap matrix; lowest sufficient prototype architecture; one finite valid/invalid witness; ordered build-from-owned slices with owners and dependencies; acceptance commands/observations; verdict matrix with owner, witnessed, sound, and verdict columns; typed negative bank; deferred production/promotion work; residue; and next owner route. Every load-bearing claim must cite the explorer return and underlying current source. Do not claim implementation, runtime, promotion, release, or publication unless current evidence proves it. The strategist, not the writer, will append research.md. Declared output target: 5500 tokens.

Evaluate findings.md only against the dispatch goal and recommend acceptance to the parent only if it answers what is currently missing, identifies the smallest defensible working prototype, contains the complete verdict matrix, preserves claim <= proof and the inventory/ontology/authority/scoring boundaries, cites current evidence through explorer returns, supplies a reproducible positive and negative witness contract, distinguishes already-deployed from build-from-owned from novel-attempt, and keeps implementation/promotion claims bounded. Return RECOMMEND_ACCEPT or one concrete revision request to the writer; the parent remains the schema-admitted final approver. Declared output target: 4000 tokens.
